Mexican Folk Art Collection
Terracotta Effigy Pipe & Artaluxpan Enamel Plaques
3 Items, Vintage
This vintage Mexican folk art lot includes three decorative pieces inspired by Mesoamerican iconography. The group features a hand-modeled terracotta clay effigy pipe sculpted in Pre-Columbian style, alongside two mid-century Artaluxpan enameled wood plaques illustrating Aztec calendar deities.
ITEMS INCLUDED:
1.
Terracotta Effigy Pipe
- Earthenware clay with painted slip accents, sculpted figure atop a serpent with bowl and stem mouthpiece

Enamel Plaque (Xocotl Huetzi)
- Artaluxpan Mexico, polychrome enamel inlay on wood, labeled on reverse
3.
Enamel Plaque (Seated Deity)
- Polychrome enamel inlay on wood, depicting seated figure with offering vessel
Condition:
Very good vintage condition across all pieces. Terracotta pipe shows natural firing variations, light surface wear, and no structural cracks. Enamel plaques retain bright coloration with intact wire outlines; one plaque shows a minor surface scratch on the wooden face. Backing labels and hanger intact.
